title: Basement use and secondary-suite classification (Council Order 2024-01)

facts.text: The appeal concerned whether a Calgary basement constituted a secondary suite and therefore required permits/upgrades.
The order reports a basement bedroom and bathroom, shared access between floors and disagreement over whether food-preparation features amounted to a cooking facility.
The respondent’s observations included bedroom-window egress and smoke-separation concerns; the appellant disputed that a secondary suite existed.
